name: Villa Cavrois
funding: CMN, the State's monuments body, runs it: State operating subsidy near EUR 45M in 2024 across 110 sites. Villa patrons: Neuflize OBC, Printemps Lille, AG2R La Mondiale foundation, Rolex.

name: Appartement témoin Perret
funding: The City of Le Havre bought the flat in 2005 for EUR 220,000 and fitted it out for EUR 150,000. The Pays d'art et d'histoire service runs the guided visits.

name: Van Doesburghuis
funding: Dutch education and culture ministry grant EUR 34,000 a year. Dutch foreign ministry refunded EUR 29,168 of maintenance in 2025. Resident rent brought in EUR 24,000.

name: Villa Majorelle
funding: The City of Nancy, owner since 2003, runs it through the Musée de l'École de Nancy. With the Fondation du patrimoine it has opened an appeal for the 2026-28 restoration.

name: Appartement-atelier Le Corbusier
funding: Patrons Cassina and Chanel and institutional partners DRAC Île-de-France (Ministry of Culture) and Région Île-de-France support the Fondation Le Corbusier, which runs it. Adult ticket EUR 10.

name: Villa Savoye
funding: CMN, the State's monuments body, runs it: State operating subsidy near EUR 45M in 2024, ticket sales EUR 91.6M in 2023, patrons EUR 3M to 4M yearly across 110 sites.

name: Cap Moderne (Villa E-1027 and Le Cabanon)
funding: Restoration cost EUR 5.5M: 55% from regional authorities and the state, 45% from private sponsors and fundraising, including Getty Foundation grants in 2016 and 2019 ($200,000 for the second).

name: Georg Kolbe Museum
funding: Run by the Georg Kolbe-Stiftung. Land Berlin gave EUR 513,624 in 2023. The museum credits the federal culture commissioner, Ernst von Siemens Kunststiftung and Hermann Reemtsma Stiftung for research.

name: Villa Esche
funding: GGG, a City of Chemnitz company, owns the villa. C3, another city company, has run events there since July 2023. Kunstsammlungen Chemnitz run the museum. Sponsors: PYUR, Adlatus.

name: Haus Ungers (Ungers Archiv für Architekturwissenschaft)
funding: Early-2025 repairs were backed by Deutsche Stiftung Denkmalschutz, NRW's heritage programme and the federal culture commissioner.

name: mayhaus
funding: Funders include Frankfurt's culture, monuments and parks offices, Hessen's science and arts ministry and monuments office, the Hessian Museum Association, Deutsche Stiftung Denkmalschutz, Wüstenrot Stiftung and Stiftung Polytechnische Gesellschaft.

name: Hohenhof (Osthaus Museum Hagen)
funding: City of Hagen property, run by its Osthaus Museum. The museum names Freunde des Osthaus Museums, Dr. Michael Otto and the Osthaus & van de Velde Gesellschaft as funders.
